crossRefs.note: They didn’t destroy the peoples, as Yahweh commanded them,
but mixed themselves with the nations, and learned their works.

people.name: Asher
people.line: Son of Jacob and Zilpah, founder of the tribe of Asher

people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

translations.web: but the Asherites lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land, for they didn’t drive them out.
translations.bsb: So the Asherites lived among the Canaanite inhabitants of the land, because they did not drive them out.
translations.kjv: But the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: for they did not drive them out.
translations.asv: but the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land; for they did not drive them out.
